## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The helper behaves as described for ASCII titles, but any letter outside a–z is treated as a separator. That breaks or empties slugs for accented and non-Latin titles. The PR description has no `## Testing` section, which AGENTS.md requires. Both module docstrings are present, so that AGENTS.md rule is met.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — `[^a-z0-9]+` is checked against `title.lower()`, so every non-ASCII letter counts as "non-alphanumeric". `slugify("Café Crème")` returns `"caf-cr-me"` and `slugify("日本語")` returns `""`. The PR says only non-alphanumeric runs are replaced, and those are alphanumeric characters. Could you normalise first (for example `unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", ...)` then drop combining marks), or match with `[\W_]+` under `re.UNICODE`? Also, could you add `("Café Crème", "cafe-creme")` and a non-Latin title to `tests/test_slug.py`? — Accented titles get broken URLs, and different all-non-Latin titles all get the same empty slug, so their page URLs collide.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- `tests/test_slug.py` covers collapsing whitespace and repeated hyphens, trimming leading and trailing hyphens, and the all-separator and empty-string inputs, and each case's expected slug matches the code.
